name: Brandenburg
summary_text: In Cottbus, 20 October 2025, a paper bin was set alight against the wall of the "Regenbogenkombinat" queer cultural centre, damaging the façade; state security (Staatsschutz) opened an arson investigation. The incident sits within a pattern: two venue attacks in the city, year-on-year far-right counter-demonstrations at the CSD (including one organised by "Deutsche Jugend voran"), and a queer community that described itself as "particularly watchful." The subsequent CSD ran under a large police presence with two counter-demonstrations but proceeded without major disruption. National score is 0.71. Brandenburg sits 0.05 below: the pattern of physical attacks on queer infrastructure (arson, incendiary devices at a housing project) with Staatsschutz involvement meets the "lone incidents barely move a score unless patterned" threshold. Mitigating: police protection was effective and the parade proceeded. Compared to Thüringen (0.65), Brandenburg's threat is concrete and physical; compared to Sachsen (the worst in the dossier with a 700+ neo-Nazi mob at Bautzen), Brandenburg's incidents are smaller in scale and met with a functional institutional response. Compared to Bayern (0.67), Brandenburg's hostility is enacted rather than merely legislative.

sources.title: CSD in Cottbus: Staatsschutz ermittelt nach Brand bei Regenbogenkombinat | Lausitzer Rundschau
sources.claim_summary: LR Online (Cottbus, 21 October 2025, dpa-based): a rubbish container was set alight on the afternoon of Monday 20 October beside the façade of the "Regenbogenkombinat" ("Bunte Welt") queer cultural centre on Thierbacher Straße in Cottbus on the CSD week; nobody was hurt and the fire was out in ~15 minutes, but the Staatsschutz took over the investigation as arson and a political motive cannot be excluded, initiatives call it an attempted firebombing, and the article places it among earlier suspected far-right attacks in the city; two counter-assemblies were registered against the CSD motto "Vereint in Frieden und Vielfalt" and the queer community is described as unusually watchful.

sources.title: Cottbuser CSD-Parade mit Großaufgebot der Polizei - zwei Gegendemos | NIEDERLAUSITZ aktuell
sources.claim_summary: Niederlausitz aktuell report on the Cottbus CSD & Niederlausitz parade (17th edition): it took place under a large police presence with two far-right counter-demonstrations (one organised by "Deutsche Jugend voran") and, despite the tense atmosphere following the Regenbogenkombinat fire, proceeded without major disruption.

sources.title: Nach Angriffen: Cottbus setzt beim CSD Zeichen gegen rechts - WELT
sources.claim_summary: Welt Regional (10 July 2026): a year on from the container fire at the Regenbogenkombinat and other suspected far-right attacks, Cottbus's CSD is presented as a deliberately colourful sign against right-wing extremism; unions and cultural organisers mobilise for the parade while the community remains uneasy about attacks believed to come from the far-right scene.
